# NodeFlow — Full Technical Documentation & Template Corpus

> NodeFlow is an open-source, local-first browser architecture and diagram studio. It unites code-based diagramming (Mermaid, Graphviz, PlantUML), bidirectional canvas manipulation, AI-assisted architectural analysis (STRIDE threat modeling, single-point-of-failure audits), and multi-format exports.

## Core Principles & Privacy Guarantee
1. **100% Client-Side Privacy**: All parsing, rendering, and AST manipulation occurs inside the client browser. No telemetry or server-side document storage.
2. **Offline-First Resilience**: Built with service worker offline caching, local IndexedDB storage, and WebGPU local LLM capabilities.
3. **Multi-Engine AI Architecture**: Supports local offline rule-based generators, in-browser WebGPU transformers, local Ollama endpoints, and user-supplied API keys for Gemini/OpenAI.

## Supported Formats (38)
| Format | Extensions | Mode | Capabilities |
|---|---|---|---|
| Mermaid | mmd, mermaid | Native | Flowcharts, ER, UML, mindmaps, Gantt, charts, and C4. |
| Graphviz DOT | dot, gv | Native | Native Graphviz layout through WebAssembly. |
| PlantUML | puml, plantuml | Derived | Sequence, class, state, activity, usecase, deployment subsets; styling and macros are not preserved. |
| D2 | d2 | Derived | Basic nodes, connections, and containers; layout and styling are approximate. |
| SQL DDL | sql | Derived | CREATE TABLE columns and foreign keys to ER schemas; dialect-specific syntax may need simplification. |
| DBML | dbml | Derived | DBML Table blocks and Ref lines to ER schemas. |
| Prisma schema | prisma | Derived | Prisma model blocks and relations to ER schemas. |
| Protobuf | proto | Derived | Proto3 message/enum blocks to class diagrams. |
| JSON Schema | schema.json | Derived | JSON-Schema properties/$defs to class diagrams. Content-detected for *.json. |
| GraphQL SDL | graphql, gql | Derived | Types, fields, and relationships to a class diagram. |
| OpenAPI / Swagger |  | Derived | JSON or YAML paths to a request sequence. Preview shows the first 10 paths. |
| AsyncAPI |  | Derived | JSON or YAML v2/v3 channels to event sequences. Preview shows the first 12 channels. |
| YAML structure | yaml, yml | Derived | Generic YAML mappings (Kubernetes, Compose) to mindmaps. Spec files auto-detect as OpenAPI/AsyncAPI. |
| ERD text | erd | Derived | Crow's-foot text (||--o{) and TABLE blocks to ER diagrams. |
| UML XMI | xmi, uml | Derived | UML2 XMI classes/generalizations/associations and lifelines/messages to class/sequence. |
| SysML v2 | sysml | Derived | SysML v2 part/requirement/action declarations to block/requirement flowcharts. |
| ArchiMate Exchange |  | Derived | ArchiMate Open Exchange elements/relationships to flowcharts. Content-detected for *.xml. |
| DMN | dmn | Derived | DMN decision tables (XML or when/then text) to flowcharts. |
| Draw.io | drawio | Derived | Compressed or plain XML nodes and edges; first page preview, approximate shapes and layout. |
| BPMN 2.0 | bpmn | Derived | Tasks, events, gateways, lanes, data objects, message flows; no BPMN execution semantics. |
| C4 / Structurizr DSL | dsl, c4 | Derived | People, systems, containers, components, code and dynamic views to C4 context. |
| Terraform HCL | tf | Derived | Resources and direct references; modules, dynamic blocks, and evaluated values are not resolved. |
| Markdown outline | md, markdown, txt | Derived | Indented lists to a mindmap. Embedded Mermaid fences can be rendered. |
| CSV relationships | csv, tsv | Derived | Source,target rows (CSV/TSV/semicolon/pipe) to a relationship graph. |
| FreeMind | mm | Derived | Topic hierarchy to a mindmap; styling and metadata remain in the original XML. |
| OPML | opml | Derived | Outline hierarchy to a mindmap. |
| XMind | xmind | Mindmap | First sheet of ZEN or legacy workbooks to an editable Mermaid mindmap; original workbook retained, fresh workbook export supported. |
| Visio VDX | vdx | Derived | Visio VDX Shape/Connect elements to flowcharts. |
| Gliffy JSON | gliffy | Derived | Gliffy stage objects/constraints to flowcharts. Content-detected for *.json. |
| Excalidraw JSON | excalidraw | Derived | Excalidraw elements (shapes/arrows) to flowcharts. Content-detected for *.json. |
| Source code → UML | ts, tsx, js, jsx, py, java, cs, go, rs, kt, kts, swift, php, rb, cpp, c, h | Derived | Best-effort class/struct/enum extraction incl. Kotlin/Swift/PHP/Ruby/C++. Not a code execution environment. |
| StarUML | mdj | Derived | StarUML model JSON (.mdj) containing UMLClass, UMLAttribute, UMLOperation, and UMLGeneralization. |
| Lucidchart | lucid, lucidchart | Derived | Lucidchart CSV or JSON export converted to Mermaid flowchart nodes and connections. |
| Adobe Illustrator | ai, ait | Derived | Adobe Illustrator artboards, vector layers, labeled groups, and path objects converted to structured visual diagrams. |
| Figma / FigJam | fig, figjam | Derived | Figma frames, component nodes, FigJam sticky notes, shapes, and connector lines converted to Mermaid flowchart. |
| OmniGraffle | graffle | Derived | OmniGraffle graphics, shape sheets, and line connections converted to Mermaid flowchart. |
| Miro | miro | Derived | Miro board items, sticky notes, cards, shapes, and connector lines converted to Mermaid flowchart. |
| GeoJSON / Geospatial (MVT, Shapefile, Protobuf) | geojson, geo.json, mvt, pbf, shp, dbf, kml, topojson | Derived | GeoJSON FeatureCollections, Mapbox Vector Tile (MVT) Protobuf schemas, ESRI Shapefile attributes, and spatial topologies converted to visual diagrams. |

## Complete Diagram Template Specifications (51)
### Class Diagram (UML Specification)
- **Template ID**: `class-diagram`
- **Description**: Object-oriented class hierarchies, private/public attributes, methods, inheritance, and composition.
- **URL**: https://muhamadzolfaghari.github.io/node-flow/templates/class-diagram/

```mermaid
classDiagram
    class CanvasController {
        -Number zoom
        -Number panX
        -Number panY
        -HTMLElement canvas
        -HTMLElement stage
        +setZoom(val, anchorX, anchorY)
        +fit(animate)
        +reset(animate)
        +measure()
        +applyTransform()
    }

    class EditorController {
        -HTMLTextAreaElement textarea
        -HTMLElement lineNumbers
        -HTMLElement statusDot
        -HTMLElement stats
        +getValue() String
        +setValue(code)
        +formatCode()
        +setStatus(type, msg)
        +updateStats()
    }

    class Exporter {
        +exportSvg(container, filename)
        +exportPng(container, scale, filename)
        +exportPdf(container, mode, filename)
        +exportMarkdown(code, filename)
        -renderToCanvas(container, scale)
    }

    class StorageManager {
        +saveDraft(code, templateId)
        +getDraft() Object
        +saveNamedDiagram(name, code, templateId)
        +listSavedDiagrams() Array
        +deleteDiagram(id)
    }

    CanvasController <|-- InteractiveStage : inherits
    CanvasController *-- MiniMapController : owns
    EditorController ..> StorageManager : autosaves
    Exporter ..> CanvasController : captures
```

### Sequence Diagram (UML Specification)
- **Template ID**: `sequence-auth`
- **Description**: Interactive message sequence with parallel activations, alt guards, and cryptographic token verification.
- **URL**: https://muhamadzolfaghari.github.io/node-flow/templates/sequence-auth/

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    actor User as User / Client
    participant App as DiagramAtlas SPA
    participant Auth as Auth Gateway (Wasm)
    participant OAuth as Identity Provider
    participant API as Backend Services

    User->>App: Click "Authorize via OAuth 2.1"
    App->>Auth: Generate PKCE code_verifier & challenge
    Auth-->>App: Hash verified (SHA-256)
    App->>OAuth: Redirect to /authorize?code_challenge
    OAuth->>User: Display consent prompt
    User->>OAuth: Grant permissions
    OAuth-->>App: Authorization Code redirect
    App->>Auth: Exchange Code + code_verifier
    Auth->>OAuth: POST /token (backchannel)
    OAuth-->>Auth: Access Token + Refresh Token (JWT)
    Auth-->>App: Secure HttpOnly Cookie session
    App->>API: GET /api/v1/projects (Bearer JWT)
    API-->>App: 200 OK (User Workspace Data)
    App-->>User: Render Canvas Dashboard
```

### State Machine Diagram (UML Specification)
- **Template ID**: `state-diagram`
- **Description**: UML finite state machine with composite states, fork transitions, and error recovery lifecycles.
- **URL**: https://muhamadzolfaghari.github.io/node-flow/templates/state-diagram/

```mermaid
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> Idle: Application Start

    state EditingSession {
        [*] --> Clean
        Clean --> Dirty: Keystroke detected
        Dirty --> Debouncing: 200ms debounce timer
        Debouncing --> Rendering: Trigger Parser
        
        state Rendering {
            [*] --> ValidatingSyntax
            ValidatingSyntax --> CompilingSVG: Syntax Valid
            ValidatingSyntax --> SyntaxError: Syntax Invalid
            CompilingSVG --> Clean: Render Success
        }
    }

    EditingSession --> PresentationMode: Press 'P' key
    PresentationMode --> EditingSession: Press 'ESC'

    EditingSession --> Exporting: Select Export (PNG / SVG / PDF)
    state Exporting {
        [*] --> HighDPIRasterize
        HighDPIRasterize --> WasmLinearMemoryComposite
        WasmLinearMemoryComposite --> BlobDownloadReady
    }
    Exporting --> EditingSession: Download complete

    EditingSession --> [*]: Close Tab
```

### Use Case Diagram (UML Specification)
- **Template ID**: `uml-usecase`
- **Description**: Actors, system boundaries, use case ovals, <<include>> dependencies, and <<extend>> extensions.
- **URL**: https://muhamadzolfaghari.github.io/node-flow/templates/uml-usecase/

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    Customer((fa:fa-user Customer))
    Admin((fa:fa-user-shield System Admin))
    BankSystem[(Core Banking Gateway)]

    subgraph SystemBoundary [Online Banking Portal]
        UC1([View Account Balances])
        UC2([Transfer Funds])
        UC3([2FA Biometric Check])
        UC4([Export PDF Statement])
        UC5([Manage Access Roles])
        UC6([Audit Incident Logs])
    end

    Customer --> UC1
    Customer --> UC2
    Customer --> UC4
    UC2 -.->|"<<include>>"| UC3
    UC4 -.->|"<<extend>>"| UC1
    UC2 --> BankSystem

    Admin --> UC5
    Admin --> UC6
    UC6 --> BankSystem
```

### Activity Diagram (UML Specification)
- **Template ID**: `uml-activity`
- **Description**: Initial node, decision diamonds, parallel fork & join synchronization bars, and activity final states.
- **URL**: https://muhamadzolfaghari.github.io/node-flow/templates/uml-activity/

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    Start((*)) --> Init[Submit Order Request]
    Init --> CheckInventory{Inventory Available?}

    CheckInventory -->|No| Backorder[Queue Backorder Notification]
    Backorder --> NotifyUser[Send Email to Customer]
    NotifyUser --> CancelOrder((X))

    CheckInventory -->|Yes| Fork1[=================== Fork Parallel ===================]
    
    Fork1 --> DeductStock[Deduct Item from Warehouse]
    Fork1 --> ChargeCard[Charge Customer Credit Card]
    Fork1 --> GenerateInvoice[Generate PDF Tax Invoice]

    DeductStock --> Join1[=================== Join Synchronization ===================]
    ChargeCard --> Join1
    GenerateInvoice --> Join1

    Join1 --> Dispatch[Dispatch Logistics Shipping Label]
    Dispatch --> CompleteFinal((O))
```

- **Template ID**: `uml-component`
- **Description**: Component stereotypes, provided and required interfaces, ports, and inter-service dependencies.

```mermaid
flowchart TD

        StockController[<<component>>\nInventory Stock Controller]
    end

    WebClient[<<component>>\nNext.js Web Client]
    MobileApp[<<component>>\nFlutter Mobile App]
    StripeAPI[(External Stripe Gateway)]
    WarehouseDB[(Warehouse Postgres DB)]

    WebClient -->|"REST / JSON"| OrderGateway
    MobileApp -->|"GraphQL"| OrderGateway
    
    OrderGateway -->|"gRPC Binary"| PaymentEngine
    OrderGateway -->|"gRPC Binary"| StockController

    PaymentEngine -->|"HTTPS / TLS 1.3"| StripeAPI
    StockController -->|"TCP / Port 5432"| WarehouseDB
```

### Deployment Diagram (UML Specification)
- **Template ID**: `uml-deployment`
- **Description**: Hardware nodes, execution environments, artifact packages, communication protocols, and cloud topology.
- **URL**: https://muhamadzolfaghari.github.io/node-flow/templates/uml-deployment/

```mermaid
flowchart TB
    subgraph ClientDevice [Client Device: macOS / Linux / Windows]
        BrowserRuntime[<<execution environment>>\nV8 / WebKit Runtime]
        SPAArtifact[<<artifact>>\nDiagramAtlas WebAssembly SPA Bundle]
        BrowserRuntime --- SPAArtifact
    end

    subgraph AWSCloud [Cloud Infrastructure: AWS us-east-1]
        subgraph EdgeCluster [Edge Network: Cloudflare CDN]
            EdgeRouter[<<node>>\nEdge TLS Termination & WAF]
        end

        subgraph K8sCluster [Kubernetes Production Cluster]
            IngressEnvoy[<<node>>\nEnvoy Ingress Gateway]
            subgraph Pod1 [DiagramAtlas Pod: Replica 1]
                FastAPIServer[<<execution environment>>\nFastAPI Python ASGI]
                WasmRustKernel[<<artifact>>\nghostwire_core.so]
                FastAPIServer --- WasmRustKernel
            end
        end

        subgraph DataVPC [Isolated Data VPC: Private Subnet]
            PostgresNode[<<node>>\nAmazon Aurora PostgreSQL Primary]
            RedisNode[<<node>>\nAmazon ElastiCache Redis Cluster]
        end
    end

    SPAArtifact -->|"HTTPS / WSS (TLS 1.3)"| EdgeRouter
    EdgeRouter -->|"Internal Backplane"| IngressEnvoy
    IngressEnvoy -->|"Cluster IP"| FastAPIServer
    FastAPIServer -->|"TCP : 5432"| PostgresNode
    FastAPIServer -->|"TCP : 6379"| RedisNode
```

### Package Diagram (UML Specification)
- **Template ID**: `uml-package`
- **Description**: Namespace decomposition, layer modularization, import dependencies, and domain-driven design bounds.
- **URL**: https://muhamadzolfaghari.github.io/node-flow/templates/uml-package/

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    subgraph PresentationLayer [<<package>> Presentation Layer]
        Controllers[API Routing Controllers]
        Presenters[JSON & Protobuf Serializers]
        Middlewares[Auth & Rate Limit Middlewares]
    end

    subgraph ApplicationLayer [<<package>> Application Layer]
        UseCases[Application Use Cases]
        Commands["Command Handlers (CQRS)"]
        Queries[Query Handlers]
    end

    subgraph DomainLayer [<<package>> Core Domain Model]
        Entities[Domain Entities]
        ValueObjects[Immutable Value Objects]
        DomainEvents[Domain Event Subsystem]
        RepositoryInterfaces[Repository Interfaces]
    end

    subgraph InfrastructureLayer [<<package>> Infrastructure Layer]
        PostgresRepos[Postgres Repository Impls]
        RedisCacheAdapter[Redis Fast-Path Cache]
        ExternalAPIs[Third-Party Service Clients]
    end

    PresentationLayer -.->|imports| ApplicationLayer
    ApplicationLayer -.->|imports| DomainLayer
    InfrastructureLayer -.->|implements| DomainLayer
```

```mermaid
    }

        :DiagramProject
        projectId = 88

        activeVersion = "v2.4"

        simdActive = true
        hardwareHash = "0x30784cd7"
    }

    UserInstance_1042 "1" --> "1..*" ProjectInstance_88 : owns
    ProjectInstance_88 "1" --> "1" WasmEngineInstance : acceleratesWith
```

### Composite Structure Diagram (UML Specification)
- **Template ID**: `uml-composite-structure`
- **Description**: Internal decomposition of complex classifiers, ports, parts, and connector bindings.
- **URL**: https://muhamadzolfaghari.github.io/node-flow/templates/uml-composite-structure/

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    subgraph SmartVehicle [Smart Vehicle: Composite Classifier]
        PortGPS((p1: GPS Port))
        PortCAN((p2: CAN Bus Port))

        subgraph TelematicsControlUnit [Telematics Control Unit]
            CellularModem[4G / 5G Modem Part]
            SecurityCrypto[Hardware Security Module]
        end

        subgraph AutonomousDrivingSystem [Autonomous Driving Subsystem]
            SensorFusion[Sensor Fusion Engine]
            PathPlanner[Path Planning Neural Core]
            ActuatorInterface[Drive-by-Wire Interface]
        end

        subgraph PowerTrain [Electric Powertrain]
            BatteryMgmt[Battery Management System]
            Inverter[Dual AC Inverter]
            Motors[Front & Rear Traction Motors]
        end

        PortGPS --- CellularModem
        CellularModem --- SecurityCrypto
        SecurityCrypto -->|"Authenticated Telemetry"| SensorFusion
        PortCAN --- SensorFusion
        SensorFusion -->|"Fused Point Cloud"| PathPlanner
        PathPlanner -->|"Steering & Torque Vector"| ActuatorInterface
        ActuatorInterface --- Inverter
        Inverter --- Motors
        BatteryMgmt --- Inverter
    end
```

### Timing Diagram (UML Specification)
- **Template ID**: `uml-timing`
- **Description**: Hardware and software state transitions across discrete clock cycles and latency windows.
- **URL**: https://muhamadzolfaghari.github.io/node-flow/templates/uml-timing/

```mermaid
timeline
    title Ultra-Low Latency Inference & Cache Timing (Sub-Millisecond Pipeline)
    0.00ms - 0.05ms : Client : Cryptographic BLAKE2b State Fingerprinting
    0.05ms - 0.10ms : Rust Wasm Kernel : Tier-0 Fast-Path Memory Cache Probe
    0.10ms - 0.85ms : Cache HIT (P50) : Return Pre-compiled Binary Protobuf Buffer
    0.85ms - 1.20ms : Network Wire : Zstandard Dictionary Decompression
    1.20ms - 2.50ms : Client Browser : Wasm Memory Injection & Instant Vector Display
```

### Interaction Overview Diagram (UML Specification)
- **Template ID**: `uml-interaction-overview`
- **Description**: Combines activity control flow with sequence interaction frames and decision guards.
- **URL**: https://muhamadzolfaghari.github.io/node-flow/templates/uml-interaction-overview/

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    InitialNode((*)) --> FrameAuth[sd: User Authentication Flow]
    FrameAuth --> DecisionAuth{Is Authenticated?}

    DecisionAuth -->|Yes| FrameWorkspace[sd: Load Collaborative Workspace Flow]
    DecisionAuth -->|No| FrameChallenge[sd: Multi-Factor Biometric Challenge Flow]

    FrameChallenge --> DecisionMFA{MFA Verified?}
    DecisionMFA -->|Success| FrameWorkspace
    DecisionMFA -->|Failure| FrameLockout[sd: Incident Log & IP Lockout]

    FrameWorkspace --> FrameLiveEdit[sd: Real-Time Vector Canvas Sync]
    FrameLiveEdit --> TerminalNode((O))
    FrameLockout --> TerminalNode
```

```mermaid
        Class

        <<metaclass>>
        Property
    }

        <<stereotype>>
        +String serviceName
        +String runtimeLanguage
        +Integer replicas
        +Boolean isStateless

        +Integer ttlSeconds

        +Boolean invalidateOnWrite

        +String cipherAlgorithm
        +String keyVaultUri
```


### Gantt Delivery Sequence — Product Roadmap (Product & Design)
- **Template ID**: `delivery-gantt`
- **Description**: Cross-functional delivery schedule with workstreams, critical paths, and milestone QA gates.
- **URL**: https://muhamadzolfaghari.github.io/node-flow/templates/delivery-gantt/

```mermaid
---
config:
  gantt:
    useWidth: 2200
    barHeight: 28
    barGap: 10
    topPadding: 60
    leftPadding: 200
    gridLineStartPadding: 45
  theme: dark
---
gantt
    title DiagramAtlas Enterprise Release Roadmap
    dateFormat YYYY-MM-DD
    axisFormat %d %b

    section Architecture & Wasm
    Design System & Tailwind v4 Tokens    :done, a1, 2026-09-01, 7d
    WebAssembly Turbo Kernel & Fast Hash  :done, a2, after a1, 10d
    Native Graphviz Wasm C Engine         :active, a3, after a2, 8d

    section Format Interop
    XMind ZEN & Draw.io Importers         :done, f1, 2026-09-12, 6d
    PlantUML, D2, SQL DDL Transpilers     :done, f2, after f1, 5d
    BPMN 2.0 & OpenAPI 3.1 Specs          :active, f3, after f2, 6d

    section Verification & Release
    End-to-End Test Suite (55 Checks)     :crit, v1, after a3, 4d
    GitHub Pages Automated Deploy         :crit, v2, after v1, 2d
    Enterprise GA v1.0 Launch             :milestone, m1, after v2, 0d
```

### Ishikawa Root-Cause Diagram (Product & Design)
- **Template ID**: `ishikawa-root-cause`
- **Description**: Quality engineering root-cause analysis across Method, Machine, Material, and People.
- **URL**: https://muhamadzolfaghari.github.io/node-flow/templates/ishikawa-root-cause/

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    subgraph ProblemBox [Core Problem Statement]
        Defect["High API Latency & Payload Bloat\n(p99 > 2,500ms / 50KB JSON)"]
    end

    subgraph CausesSpine [6M Root Cause Dimensions]
        direction TB
        subgraph Machine [Infrastructure & Hardware]
            M1[CPU Throttling on Shared Pods]
            M2[Unpooled Database Connections]
        end
        subgraph Method [Architecture & Protocol]
            M3[Missing Tier-0 In-Memory Cache]
            M4[Verbose Text JSON Protocol]
        end
        subgraph Material [Payloads & Inference]
            M5[Uncompressed 50KB Payloads]
            M6[LLM Preamble & Polite Filler]
        end
    end

    Machine --> Defect
    Method --> Defect
    Material --> Defect
```

### Entity Relationship Schema (Engineering & Data)
- **Template ID**: `er-diagram`
- **Description**: Relational database schema with Crow’s Foot cardinality notation, primary keys, and foreign keys.
- **URL**: https://muhamadzolfaghari.github.io/node-flow/templates/er-diagram/

```mermaid
erDiagram
    ORGANIZATION ||--o{ USER : contains
    ORGANIZATION ||--o{ PROJECT : owns
    USER ||--o{ PROJECT_MEMBER : participates
    PROJECT ||--o{ PROJECT_MEMBER : assigns
    PROJECT ||--o{ DIAGRAM : stores
    DIAGRAM ||--o{ DIAGRAM_VERSION : tracks
    USER ||--o{ AUDIT_LOG : triggers

    ORGANIZATION {
        uuid id PK
        string name
        string plan_tier
        timestamp created_at
    }

    USER {
        uuid id PK
        string email
        string full_name
        string role
        boolean is_active
    }

    PROJECT {
        uuid id PK
        uuid organization_id FK
        string title
        string visibility
        timestamp updated_at
    }

    DIAGRAM {
        uuid id PK
        uuid project_id FK
        string name
        string format
        text current_source
        string checksum_hash
    }

    DIAGRAM_VERSION {
        uuid id PK
        uuid diagram_id FK
        integer version_number
        text source_snapshot
        string author_id
        timestamp snapshot_at
    }
```

```mermaid
        id: 1.1
        text: All network communications must be mutual TLS encrypted and strictly authenticated.
        risk: high
        verifymethod: test
    }
    functionalRequirement req_token_rotation {
        id: 1.2
        text: Access tokens must rotate automatically every 15 minutes with cryptographic replay protection.
        risk: medium
        verifymethod: test
    }
    performanceRequirement req_auth_sla {
        id: 2.1
        text: Authentication handshakes must complete within 50ms at p99 under 10k RPS load.
        risk: medium
        verifymethod: demonstration
    }
    interfaceRequirement req_oidc_federation {
        id: 3.1
        text: Support standard OIDC and SAML 2.0 identity providers for enterprise SSO.
        risk: low
        verifymethod: inspection
    }

    element identity_gateway {
        type: service
    }
    element vault_kms {
        type: subsystem
    }
    element redis_session_cache {
        type: storage
    }

    identity_gateway - satisfies -> req_core_zero_trust
    identity_gateway - satisfies -> req_token_rotation
    identity_gateway - traces -> req_oidc_federation
    vault_kms - satisfies -> req_token_rotation
    redis_session_cache - satisfies -> req_auth_sla
```

### QA Defect Lifecycle & Bug Triage Workflow (QA & Testing)
- **Template ID**: `qa-defect-lifecycle`
- **Description**: Complete defect state machine from discovery and triage prioritization to developer fix, QA verification, and production closure.
- **URL**: https://muhamadzolfaghari.github.io/node-flow/templates/qa-defect-lifecycle/

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    NewBug["New Bug Reported"] --> Triage{"Triage Review"}
    Triage -- "Invalid / Cannot Reproduce" --> Rejected["Rejected / Closed"]
    Triage -- "Duplicate" --> Dup["Closed as Duplicate"]
    Triage -- "Confirmed" --> Prioritize{"Severity Assessment"}
    Prioritize -- "P0 Blocker" --> Hotfix["Immediate Hotfix Squad"]
    Prioritize -- "P1 / P2" --> Backlog["Sprint Backlog"]
    Hotfix --> DevFix["Developer Fix & PR"]
    Backlog --> DevFix
    DevFix --> CodeReview["Peer Code Review"]
    CodeReview --> DeployQA["Deployed to QA Test Env"]
    DeployQA --> ReTest{"QA Verification"}
    ReTest -- "Failed" --> ReOpen["Reopened with Trace Logs"]
    ReOpen --> DevFix
    ReTest -- "Passed" --> PreProd["Staging Regression Pass"]
    PreProd --> ProdDeploy["Deploy to Production"]
    ProdDeploy --> Done["Closed & Verified in Prod"]
```

### Scientific Method & Lab Experiment Protocol (Education & Research)
- **Template ID**: `scientific-method-lab`

```mermaid
    Obs["1. Real-World Observation"] --> Question["2. Formulate Research Question"]

    LitReview --> Hypo["4. Formulate Testable Hypothesis"]
    Hypo --> Protocol["5. Design Controlled Experiment"]
    Protocol --> RunExp["6. Conduct Experiment & Gather Data"]
    RunExp --> Analyze{"7. Statistical Data Analysis"}
    Analyze -- "Hypothesis Supported" --> DrawConc["8. Draw Scientific Conclusions"]
    Analyze -- "Hypothesis Refuted" --> Refine["Refine or Formulate New Hypothesis"]
    Refine --> Protocol
    DrawConc --> PeerReview["9. Peer Review & Publication"]
    PeerReview --> Repeat["10. Independent Replication by Scientific Community"]
```

```mermaid
    end

    subgraph Processing["2. Spatial Processing & Storage"]
        PostGIS[("PostgreSQL + PostGIS (H3 Spatial Indexes)")]
        Tippecanoe["Tippecanoe Vector Tile Compressor"]
        ProtobufGen["Mapbox Vector Tile (MVT / Protobuf) Encoder"]
    end

    subgraph Distribution["3. Global Vector Tile Distribution"]
        S3["Cloud Object Storage (PMTiles / MBTiles)"]
        CDN["Global Edge CDN Cache"]
        MapClient["Maplibre / Mapbox Vector Tile Renderer"]
    end

    SHP --> PostGIS
    GPS --> PostGIS
    OSM --> PostGIS
    PostGIS --> Tippecanoe
    Tippecanoe --> ProtobufGen
    ProtobufGen --> S3
    S3 --> CDN
    CDN --> MapClient
```

### Mapbox Vector Tile (MVT) Protobuf Specification (Engineering & Data)
- **Template ID**: `mvt-vector-tile-protobuf-spec`
- **Description**: Binary Protobuf encoding specification for Mapbox Vector Tiles (MVT): Tile layers, geometry commands, feature tags, and value dictionaries.
- **URL**: https://muhamadzolfaghari.github.io/node-flow/templates/mvt-vector-tile-protobuf-spec/

```mermaid
classDiagram
    %% Mapbox Vector Tile (MVT) Protobuf Specification
    class Tile {
        +Layer[] layers
        +uint32 version
        +decodeTile(z, x, y)
    }
    class Layer {
        +string name
        +Feature[] features
        +string[] keys
        +Value[] values
        +uint32 extent
        +uint32 version
    }
    class Feature {
        +uint64 id
        +uint32[] tags
        +GeomType type
        +uint32[] geometry
    }
    class Value {
        +string string_value
        +float float_value
        +double double_value
        +int64 int_value
        +bool bool_value
    }
    class GeomType {
        <<enumeration>>
        UNKNOWN : 0
        POINT : 1
        LINESTRING : 2
        POLYGON : 3
    }
    Tile *-- Layer : contains
    Layer *-- Feature : encodes
    Layer *-- Value : dictionary
    Feature --> GeomType : classifies
```


## Frequently Asked Questions (AEO & GEO Direct Answers)
### Is NodeFlow free?
Yes. NodeFlow is open source under the MIT license, with no account, watermark, or paywall. If you connect a third-party AI provider, that provider may charge for its own usage.

### Is my data private?
Projects, parsing, rendering, and exports run in your browser, and drafts are stored in your browser storage. NodeFlow has no backend of its own. If you choose Gemini or an OpenAI-compatible provider, the prompt you submit (and the active file when you insert into it) is sent to that provider. The deterministic, Ollama, and WebGPU engines do not send it to a cloud service.

### Do I need an API key to use AI?
No. The deterministic engine works instantly without a key, the WebGPU engine runs a small model on your device after a one-time download, and Ollama uses a model on your own machine. Gemini and OpenAI-compatible engines need your own key.

### What can I import and export?
Import Mermaid, PlantUML, Graphviz DOT, Draw.io, D2, SQL, OpenAPI, XMind, Markdown, CSV and many more listed on the Formats page. Export SVG, PNG, PDF, PPTX, standalone HTML, source files, and project backups.

### Can I use it offline?
After the first load, editing, rendering, and exports run client-side. Cloud AI providers and web fonts need a connection.

### How is it different from the Mermaid Live Editor?
NodeFlow adds multi-file projects with version checkpoints, direct canvas editing for flowcharts, converters for dozens of formats, role-based templates, themes, and an AI assistant that shows a reviewable proposal before changing your files.
